no-permission: <red>You don't have permission to use CameraTrack.</red>
player-only: <red>This command can only be used by a player.</red>
create.invalid-name: <red>Name must be 1-32 letters, digits, underscores or dashes.</red>
create.success: <gray>Created track <yellow><name></yellow>. Stand at the first camera position and use <white>/<label> add <name></white>.</gray>
list.empty: <gray>No tracks yet. Create one with <white>/camera create <name></white>.</gray>
add.success: <gray>Added node <yellow>#<index></yellow> <dark_gray>(camera <white><x>, <y>, <z></white>)</dark_gray>; it will connect smoothly to its neighbours.</gray>
insert.success: <gray>Inserted node at position <yellow><index></yellow>; track now has <yellow><count></yellow> nodes.</gray>
set.field-invalid: <red>Unknown field. Available: <white>duration, hold, ease, yaw, pitch, path, type, command, title, subtitle, title-fade-in, title-stay, title-fade-out</white></red>
play.too-few: <red>A track needs at least two playable nodes; this one has <yellow><count></yellow>.</red>
play.invalid.bezier-only: <red>This track contains only Bezier nodes and cannot be played. A Bezier node must sit between two default nodes.</red>
play.invalid.bezier: <red>Bezier node #<index> must have a default node immediately before it; the node after it may be default or cut (not at the start, not after a cut node, and not adjacent to another Bezier node).</red>
stop.not-playing: <red>That player is not playing a camera track.</red>
stop.success: <gray>Playback stopped and your state was restored.</gray>
stop.self-not-playing: <red>You are not playing a camera track.</red>
preview.too-few: <red>A track needs at least two nodes.</red>
tool.given: <gray>Received the <gold>camera tool</gold>: right-click to add a node / Shift+right-click to open the track UI / left-click to preview / Shift+left-click to switch tracks.</gray>
goto.busy: <red>Stop the current playback before teleporting to a node.</red>
set.hold-range: <red>Hold time must be between 0 and 600 seconds.</red>
play.no-permission: <red>You don't have permission to play camera tracks.</red>
stop.no-permission: <red>You don't have permission to stop playback.</red>
ui.busy: <red>Cannot open the editor while playing. Run /camera stop first.</red>
admin.required: <red>You don't have permission to do that (requires <white>cameratrack.admin</white>).</red>
tool.no-track: <gray>No tracks yet. Create one with <white>/camera create <name></white>.</gray>
tool.add.success: <gray>Added node <yellow>#<index></yellow> to <yellow><name></yellow>; track now has <yellow><count></yellow> nodes.</gray>
join.restored: <gray>Your previous playback ended unexpectedly; you were returned to the start and your state was restored.</gray>
join.restored-no-world: <gray>Your previous playback ended unexpectedly; your state was restored (the original world was not loaded, so you were not teleported).</gray>
tool.empty: <gray>No nodes yet; right-click to add the first camera position.</gray>
tool.more: <gray>…and <count> more node(s); use <white>/camera nodes <name></white> to see all.</gray>
game-mode-locked: <red>You cannot change gamemode during camera playback.</red>
gui.main.title: <gold>CameraTrack tracks</gold>
gui.main.body.count: <gray><count> track(s). Pick one to edit, or create a new one.</gray>
gui.main.body.hint: <gray>Tip: the track page can add nodes, play and toggle loop; the node page edits hold/fly/ease/path/command and the title shown on arrival.</gray>
gui.track.title: <gold>Track: <name></gold>
gui.track.body.empty: <gray>No nodes yet: use “Add node” below to record your current position as the first camera shot.</gray>
gui.track.body.too-many: <gray>Too many nodes; only the first <shown> are shown. Edit the rest with commands.</gray>
gui.track.body.path-note: <gray>Adjacent nodes on the same plane (any axis equal) connect in a straight line; others follow the view direction as an arc. Set a node's path to line / curve / arc to override.</gray>
gui.track.add.tooltip: <gray>Record your eye position and rotation as a new node</gray>
gui.track.loop.tooltip: <gray>Toggle the default loop state of this track</gray>
gui.track.flow.tooltip: <gray>On: pass through nodes continuously; off: ease per segment</gray>
gui.track.return.tooltip: <gray>On: end where you started; off: stay at the last node</gray>
gui.node.title: <gold>Node #<index> · <track></gold>
gui.node.body.hint: <gray>Change the inputs and press “Save settings”. Path auto means a straight line on the same plane and a view arc otherwise.</gray>
gui.node.body.type-hint: <gray>Type: Default = passed normally; Cut = jump straight to the next node after the hold; Bezier = never played, only a control point between two default nodes.</gray>
gui.node.body.title-hint: <gray>Title text accepts MiniMessage or a vanilla JSON text component (starting with {); both support colors and translation keys. \<player> is replaced with your name; leave empty to show nothing.</gray>
gui.node.input.title: <gray>Title on arrival (optional)</gray>
gui.node.input.subtitle: <gray>Subtitle (optional)</gray>
gui.node.update.tooltip: <gray>Replace this node's position and rotation with your current view</gray>
gui.create.title: <gold>New track</gold>
gui.create.body: <gray>Give the new track a name, then add camera nodes to it.</gray>
gui.create.input.name: <gray>Track name (letters/digits/underscore/dash)</gray>
gui.confirm.delete-track.title: <red>Delete track: <name></red>
gui.confirm.delete-track.body: <gray>The track and all of its nodes will be deleted permanently.</gray>
gui.confirm.delete-node.title: <red>Delete node #<index></red>
gui.confirm.delete-node.body: <gray>This camera node will be removed and its neighbours reconnect automatically.</gray>
nodes.title: <dark_gray>|</dark_gray> <gold>title <white><title></white></gold>
nodes.subtitle: <dark_gray>|</dark_gray> <gold>subtitle <white><subtitle></white></gold>
title.invalid: <red>Could not parse title text (MiniMessage or a vanilla JSON text component): <value></red>
title.range: <red>Title times must be between 0 and 600 seconds.</red>
